author: 5kO0
content:
Implemented (this session). Test infrastructure landed; surfaced a real cross-impl bug filed as #30.

What's added:
  proto-blue-interop-tests/ts-runner/package.json   — added @atproto/repo 0.9.1
  proto-blue-interop-tests/ts-runner/index.mjs      — new mst_root_cid op (builds an MST from input entries and returns the root CID multibase)
  proto-blue-interop-tests/Cargo.toml               — added proto-blue-repo dev-dep
  proto-blue-interop-tests/tests/differential.rs    — new mst_corpus(), mst_fixture(), mst_entries_wire(), build_rust_mst(), and three diff tests

Tests:
  differential_mst_root_cid_single_leaf — PASSES live. One-entry MSTs match byte-exact across impls. Validates the test infrastructure works.
  differential_mst_root_cid_multi_leaf — #[ignore]'d. 6-fixture corpus exercising sibling ordering, prefix-compression edge cases, TID-shaped keys (the audit's predicted split-point divergence area), 50-key stress test. Currently FAILS live with cross-impl divergence on the 2-leaf case (concrete repro: [(\"coll/a\", X), (\"coll/b\", Y)] → Rust bafyreibakm... vs TS bafyreigdk2...). Tracked separately as #30.
  differential_mst_root_cid_insertion_order_independent — #[ignore]'d. Same scrambled-input fixture validation.

Adversarial corpus covers (when #30 is fixed and tests un-#[ignore]'d):
  - Empty trees (skipped — single-leaf is the minimum interesting case)
  - Single entry (passes)
  - Two entries (currently diverges — minimum reproducer)
  - Dense small set, exercises sibling ordering
  - TID-shaped real-world atproto keys, scattered-hash distribution
  - Mixed collections, varied leading-byte patterns for prefix-compression edges
  - 50-key stress

Verification (rust-quality §honest reporting):
  cargo build --workspace                                           PASS
  cargo test --workspace                                            PASS (67 suites, 0 failures — single-leaf passes, multi-leaf cleanly ignored)
  cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings             PASS
  cargo fmt --all --check                                           PASS
  TS_RUNNER_READY=1 cargo test ...differential_mst — single-leaf live: PASS
  Multi-leaf live (run with -- --ignored): FAILS as designed, matching the divergence repro in #30

Behavioural change: none in production code. New TS dep (@atproto/repo) only used in the test harness.

Category: A (root-cause) — added the missing cross-impl validation pathway end-to-end. The test correctly fails on a real bug; that's the test's job. The bug (#30) is a separable fix.

The audit's prediction was specifically that the MST split-point logic needed cross-impl validation because no test had ever pinned it. The test pinned it; a divergence surfaced; the underlying impl needs investigation. This is exactly the success mode the audit envisaged — bugs surfaced in CI rather than in production traffic.

Suggested next: file #30 (done above), continue to #27 (CAR layout parity) and #28 (commit construction parity) — those compose on top of MST so the diagnostic from #30 will likely localise issues for both.
